description: This file contains internal definitions and structures for cryptographic digest functions in BoringSSL, including function pointers for digest operations and context management.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Hashes data into the digest context.

methods.name: final
methods.description: Completes the hash and outputs the digest.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees the pctx when the digest context is freed.

methods.name: dup
methods.description: Duplicates the pctx when copying the digest context.
